files.html:
Dochi RPG Maker v0.1.0 Release Notes

Initial public release of Dochi RPG Maker, an in-game RPG maker toolkit for Forge 1.20.1 and CustomNPCs-based modpacks.

Added

  • Dialogue Editor for dialogue sets, nodes, routes, choices, conditions, and actions.
  • GUI Maker for dialogue, shop, currency HUD, and RPG layout JSON editing.
  • NPC Shop Editor for buy/sell shop JSON, shop GUI selection, item setup, stock, prices, and currency selection.
  • Item-based Currency Editor with pickup absorption, balance display, price policies, death loss rules, and HUD settings.
  • Currency HUD editing through JSON-backed GUI layout data.
  • NPC Basic Editor for selected CustomNPCs NPCs, including display, faction, combat, AI, inventory, equipment, and drop table settings.
  • Server-side JSON load, save, delete, and refresh workflow for multiplayer use.
  • OP permission checks for server editing actions.
  • Editor selection and NPC target workflows using the Dochi RPG Maker Core item.
  • Early public API/registry structure for future editor and addon expansion.

Work in Progress

  • Bank and banker tools are experimental.
  • Some CustomNPCs advanced systems may still need further polish.
  • Addon-facing API compatibility is being improved over time.

Notes

Runtime data is stored in the dochi_rpg_maker folder. The internal mod id may still appear as dochi_game_editor for compatibility with earlier development builds.
